input: Compare broadband providers for a better deal

gold.taskTitle: Compare broadband providers for a better deal
gold.taskDescription: Research and compare broadband providers available to the user in order to find a better deal than their current plan.

questions.title: Who is your current broadband provider and plan?
questions.description: Understand the user's existing provider, package name, and monthly cost to use as a baseline for comparison.

questions.title: What is your full postcode or address?
questions.description: Determine the user's location so that only providers with available coverage in their area are considered.

questions.title: What monthly price would feel like a better deal?
questions.description: Establish the user's target budget or maximum monthly spend for a new broadband package.

questions.title: What minimum download speed do you need?
questions.description: Identify the speed threshold the user requires to support their household's internet usage.

questions.title: How many people regularly use the internet at home?
questions.description: Gauge household demand to recommend packages with sufficient capacity and reliability.

questions.title: Do you need a landline phone included in the package?
questions.description: Find out whether the user requires a bundled phone line or is happy with broadband only.

questions.title: When does your current contract end?
questions.description: Determine whether the user can switch immediately or needs to plan around an exit date to avoid early termination fees.
